title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK has been updated to comply with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA accessibility standards.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should assess if the updated accessibility compliance aligns with its own application requirements.

impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android SDK version 24, affecting devices running older Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its integration to meet the new minimum SDK requirement.

backbase_rationale: Ensures compliance with fraud protection regulations.
